workspace.description: The workspace the task stands in, by the slug list_workspaces answered: required with a key, and with an id the workspace that must hold the task; leave it out with an id for whichever workspace it stands in.

taskId.description: The task whose description to edit, by the id list_tasks answered, or by its key, such as ACME-42, with the workspace it stands in.

section.description: The heading the point goes under, copied exactly from the description's text, without its #s. A heading the text does not hold opens a new section at its end.

text.description: The new point, added at the end of the section: Markdown, a bullet where the section is a list.

find.description: Text copied exactly from the description's saved text, as much as names one place: a phrase, lines, or whole sections, headings and their #s included.

text.description: What that text becomes, which may open headings of its own; empty to delete it, and a line the deletion leaves empty is taken out.

notes.description: The notes the latest lines call for, in order, taken together or not at all; empty when nothing new was said.
